results.title: Degree-sensitive dense tensor isomorphism from Cayley algorithms
results.question: Give a reduction from dense finite-field 3TI to group isomorphism or group transporter search whose output multiplication-table size is subexponential in the sum of tensor mode dimensions at fixed field order.
results.result: A linear-log-order class-two Cayley encoding over every fixed finite field, optimal for balanced objectwise encodings.

results.title: Free-module versus arbitrary-module tensor complexity
results.question: Determine when 3TI_R and 3FTI_R coincide under polynomial reductions for finite commutative rings R, with module presentations rather than expanded element tables.
results.result: Presented-module and free three-tensor isomorphism are polynomial-time many-one equivalent over every fixed finite commutative ring.

results.title: Exact local-unitary equivalence of mixed states
results.question: For two rational bipartite density matrices of growing local dimensions, decide local-unitary equivalence in polynomial bit time without a nondegeneracy promise.
results.result: Gaussian-rational mixed-state local unitary equivalence and three-factor unitary tensor isomorphism reduce to each other in polynomial bit time.

results.title: Smoothability of fixed subalgebras
results.question: Characterize when the invariant algebra A^G of a finite smoothable commutative algebra A with a finite group action G in characteristic zero is smoothable.
results.result: The complex squarefree third Veronese family first becomes nonsmoothable with seven variables, at length 43.

results.title: Super-logarithmic partition and analytic rank separation
results.question: Over finite fields, let A(d)=sup_T partitionRank(T)/analyticRank(T), allowing the field and format to vary. Is A(d)/log d unbounded and does it tend to infinity?
results.result: An explicit rank-one form gives exponential partition-to-raw-analytic rank separation, and the determinant has an exact fixed-field analytic rank formula.

results.title: Monomial-LCD canonicalization without a supplied normalization
results.question: Classify the complexity of choosing equivariantly an LCD representative of a monomial code orbit over fields of size greater than three, with reversible transport data.
results.result: Over fields of size greater than three, reversibly normalize to an LCD code and recover ordinary monomial canonization from an LCD canonizer.

results.title: Equivalence of codes under mixed blockwise metrics
results.question: Compare two marked code decompositions using Hamming isometries on one block and rank-metric isometries on another. Classify equivalence on raw generator matrices when the blocks share input row transformations.
results.result: Mixed Hamming and matrix-rank code equivalence with a compatible shared action is polynomial-time equivalent to tensor isomorphism.

results.title: Distinct kernels among marked quotient maps
results.question: Count normal subgroups K of G for which G/K≅H and for which supplied subgroups L_i have pairwise distinct images. Determine the complexity in Cayley-table and explicit subgroup-generator input.
results.result: Count distinct marked quotient kernels in polynomial time for nonabelian semisimple Cayley-table targets.

results.title: Maximal epimorphic subdirect quotient
results.question: Given three Cayley tables G,H1,H2 and epimorphism feasibility to each target, compute the maximum possible order of the image of (φ1,φ2):G→H1×H2 as the two epimorphisms vary.
results.result: Find a maximum simultaneous image in polynomial time for nonabelian semisimple targets with optional square-free-exponent abelian direct factors.

results.title: Counting distinct optimal core-free point stabilizers
results.question: For class-two permutation-generator p-groups admitting an exact polynomial-time transitive degree algorithm, determine a polynomial-bit algorithm or counting hardness for the number of maximum-order core-free subgroups, up to conjugacy.
results.result: Counting optimal stabilizer conjugacy classes is #P-hard at every fixed odd prime even with an explicit optimum and a maximizing stabilizer.

results.title: Read-once word reachability in finite quasigroups
results.question: Given a table-defined finite quasigroup, a multiset of named inputs, and a target element, classify the complexity of finding a parenthesized product that uses each named occurrence exactly once and evaluates to the target.
results.result: Read-once parenthesized product reachability is NP-complete even for explicitly tabulated commutative quasigroups.

results.title: Polynomial-depth circuit witness search from quasigroup membership
results.question: Construct a uniform NC procedure outputting a term circuit of polynomial size witnessing membership in a generated subquasigroup whenever it exists.
results.result: Uniform NC³ constructs polynomial-size straight-line membership witnesses in explicitly tabulated quasigroups.

results.title: Smoothness of exact ABP realization varieties
results.question: Can one characterize all smooth points of the Zariski closure of bounded-size commutative ABP outputs at growing degree by minimum-width presentations?
results.result: An explicit cut-capacity test characterizes smoothness for fixed-order tensor-train varieties, including redundant caps and simultaneous rank drops.

results.title: Small-characteristic shallow reconstruction
results.question: Can black-box constant-top-fan-in depth-three circuits be reconstructed in polynomial bit time uniformly over explicit finite fields?
results.result: Single products admit randomized polynomial reconstruction with extension-field queries, and distinct formal products can have identical base-field evaluations.

results.title: Robust shallow circuit reconstruction
results.question: Can depth-three circuit decompositions over R be recovered with polynomial bit complexity from bounded-error evaluations under quantitative identifiability promises?
results.result: Reconstruct real three-block depth-three circuits from bounded coefficient noise under explicit separation and conditioning assumptions.

results.title: Border top fan-in hierarchy with growing bottom degree
results.question: Quantify how far the exponential-in-n border lower bound for the sum of k+1 disjoint degree-n products survives when the bottom fan-in bound grows with n and top fan-in stays k.
results.result: Give growing-bottom-degree bounds for the elementary symmetric polynomial and match them in the chunk-aligned border model.

results.title: Efficient Waring coordinate multiplicities
results.question: Can representation multiplicities in bounded-Waring-rank coordinate rings be computed with fixed-parameter dependence on rank?
results.result: Compute representation multiplicities of binary Waring secants in time polynomial in the numerical degrees and secant rank.

results.title: Low-degree sparse factors with no spurious candidates
results.question: Recover precisely the irreducible factors of individual degree at most a fixed d from a sparse rational input of unbounded individual degree in polynomial input-plus-output bit time.
results.result: Recover the bounded-individual-degree rational factor set with high probability, with expected output-sensitive time for sparse expansion.

results.title: Intersection-number criteria for bounded bases
results.question: For arbitrary k>=3, find nontrivial explicit conditions on intersection numbers guaranteeing combinatorial base number at most k.
results.result: Give an intersection-number certificate that the fibers of a coherent configuration determine all pair colors.

results.title: Transporter recovery from algebraic configuration isomorphism
results.question: Identify a polynomial-time recognizable class beyond separable schemes where a supplied algebraic isomorphism can be lifted to a vertex permutation despite large bases.
results.result: Lift prescribed color isomorphisms in polynomial time on coherent configurations of bounded fiber size, including nonseparable homogeneous examples.

results.title: Stable reconstruction from corrupted vertex decks
results.question: For G drawn from G(n,1/2), determine the sharp fraction of adversarially replaced or missing vertex cards permitting polynomial-time unique reconstruction with high probability.
results.result: With high probability a dense random graph has sharp polynomial-time vertex-deck recovery threshold 2e+f≤n−3 for e replacements and f erasures.

results.title: Polynomial-time graph-state LU with unknown permutation
results.question: Give a polynomial-time procedure deciding graph-state LU equivalence when one global qubit permutation is also allowed, or classify it by reductions to a known equivalence problem.
results.result: Permutation-allowed graph-state local-unitary equivalence is GI-hard and is GI-equivalent on the recognizable two-private-leaves family.

results.title: Exact enumeration of local-unitary graph-state symmetries
results.question: Output a compact representation of all one-qubit local unitaries carrying a given graph state to itself, separating finite components from continuous ones, using time polynomial in graph order.
results.result: Compute compact local and permutation-allowed graph-state stabilizers when two-body marginals isolate local Pauli axes.

results.title: Simultaneous local-unitary equivalence of multiple graph states
results.question: Decide whether one tensor product of local unitaries carries every state in a supplied ordered list of graph states to its matched target, in time polynomial in total graph input size.
results.result: Decide simultaneous graph-state transport when a qualifying anchor forces monomial local unitaries.

results.title: Fixed cyclic alphabet for arbitrarily strong surface hardness
results.question: Determine the sharp polynomial-time approximation threshold for weighted 1-homology localization over one fixed odd prime coefficient field on closed triangulated surfaces of unbounded genus.
results.result: Rational-weight orientable surface localization and fixed-prime weighted difference constraints have the same approximation threshold.

results.title: Approximation on surfaces with unbounded boundary components
results.question: Determine whether a uniform PTAS is possible for weighted localization of a relative 1-homology class on orientable surfaces with fixed genus and unbounded distinct boundary components.
results.result: A deterministic FPTAS minimizes binary relative homology support on fixed-genus orientable surfaces with arbitrarily many boundary components.

GP-0251.result: Chen and Zhao prove that the determinant has partition rank d-o(d), uniformly over fields.

GP-0252.result: Chen and Zhao obtain a linear-order partition-to-geometric rank separation.

GP-0542.result: Lean checks two first-jet identities supporting the previously answered generic ABP tangent bound.
